## Story submission

<!-- Product-facing contributors should use the app's story language. This
     checklist is maintainer-facing backstage metadata. -->

- [ ] I identified the contributor and co-creators.
- [ ] I stated whether the material is original, adapted, quoted, or assisted.
- [ ] I stated the requested outcome: personal work, open path, proposed canon,
      or published alternate path.
- [ ] I recorded restrictions, attribution requirements, and permission scope.
- [ ] I added the applicable `state:*` label without treating it as a decision.
- [ ] A human steward will make the editorial and rights decision.
